limits: Finite prefixes plus repeatable control-state arguments, not observed infinite host executions.
Donation/withdrawal C fixed-point tests are separate; no pthread scheduling privilege is changed.
Fair CPU scheduling alone need not impose fair lock acquisition; deadline admission additionally needs bounded predecessors, critical work and interference.

ordering.minimize.edge: payload write -> release ready -> reads-from acquire -> payload read
ordering.minimize.reuse: last payload read -> release retirement -> reads-from acquire -> overwrite
ordering.minimize.limits: This operational minimizer does not model weak visibility; the separately imported MP model and handoff proof supply those ordering obligations.

handoff.model.limits: Two generations, fixed enrolled readers, no cancellation. Weak-memory ordering requires the separate RF/SW proof; model is not all C executions.

limits: Author implementation/execution only; no independent review, delayed learner assessment or physical observation.
Finite schedules/search/models do not prove general fairness, liveness, all histories or absolute mastery.
Performance comparisons use ordinary optimized profiles only; instrumented runs validate behavior. Host affinity is inspected, never changed; no scheduling privileges or host policy changes.
Cache addresses and elapsed time are not hardware coherence-traffic measurements; reported line size and timing remain host-specific.
Weak-order changed packet uses explicit restricted models, not execution on a weakly ordered physical target.
Current mutex totals change the intermediate freshness contract explicitly; private/batched and per-item schemes share only the final result contract.
Changed queue shutdown settles admitted calls before discarding residue; cancellation may be delivered after commit and does not imply rollback.
Exact final published C17/C23 and all externally assessed/physical obligations remain separately open.
